name: Fallen Warlord: Undefeated Champion
description: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: Faltering Armor
abilities.description: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

abilities.name: Shattering Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

abilities.name: Endless Legions
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

abilities.name: Circle of Defilement
abilities.description: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Doombringer
abilities.description: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.
